title: Fries with That?
overview: Fries with That is a sitcom about the hilarious antics of a group of teens who run havoc running a fast food joint. Pattie, Robyn, Tess and Alex are way too concerned with friends, dating, body image, and the in-crowd to bother much with actually working. All the while, the assistant manager Ben is going nuts trying to get them to flip burgers and actually serve customers.
